questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Time Preposition with Seasons
questions.question:
Fill in the blank with the correct preposition:
"The High Court registry observes modified working hours ___ summer to avoid the extreme desert heat."
questions.explanation: Seasons (summer, winter, spring, autumn) broad time periods hote hain aur inke pehle preposition 'IN' use hota hai: 'in summer', 'in winter'.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Time Preposition Pyramid — IN for seasons, months, years, and decades.
questions.hint: Seasons ke pehle kaunsa temporal preposition lagta hai?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Day-Part Compound Temporal Expression
questions.question:
Choose the correct preposition to fill the blank:
"The Chief Justice inspected the digitization infrastructure ___ Sunday afternoon."
questions.explanation: Jab part of day ('afternoon') ke pehle day ka naam ('Sunday') jud jata hai, toh formula 'ON + Day + Part of Day' apply hota hai: 'on Sunday afternoon'. Agar sirf 'afternoon' hota toh 'in the afternoon' lagta.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Time Preposition Pyramid — ON for named days and day-part compounds.
questions.hint: Day name judne par 'in' badal kar kya ban jata hai?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Omission with Deictic Adverbs (this, last, next)
questions.question:
Spot the error in the sentence:
"The appellant appeared / before the Division Bench / on last Tuesday / to present fresh evidence."
questions.explanation: Jab kisi time noun (Tuesday, week, month, year) ke pehle 'last', 'next', 'this', ya 'every' jud jaye, toh preposition (on/in/at) completely drop ho jata hai (Zero Preposition). Correct phrasing hai 'last Tuesday', NOT '*on last Tuesday'.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Zero Preposition with 'this, last, next, every'.
questions.hint: Kya 'last Tuesday' ke pehle 'on' lagna chahiye?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Place Preposition: Exact Address with Street Number
questions.question:
Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition:
"The registered office of the State Legal Services Authority is located ___ 15, High Court Road."
questions.explanation: Jab street address ke sath building ya house number ('15') specified ho, toh wo pinpoint location (1D point) ban jata hai aur strictly 'AT' lagta hai: 'at 15, High Court Road'. Agar building number na hota aur sirf road hoti, tab 'on High Court Road' lagta.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-02: Place Preposition Matrix — AT for exact street addresses containing numbers.
questions.hint: House / building number ke sath kaunsa preposition lagta hai?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Place Preposition: Building Floors
questions.question:
Fill in the blank:
"The computer server room of the registry is situated ___ the second floor of the new judicial complex."
questions.explanation: Building ke floors (ground floor, first floor, second floor) flat surface levels hote hain aur inke pehle standardly 'ON' lagta hai: 'on the second floor'.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-02: Place Preposition Matrix — ON for building floors and levels.
questions.hint: Floors ke pehle 'on' lagate hain ya 'in'?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Relative Position: Above vs Over on a Scale
questions.question:
Fill in the blank:
"During peak summer in Jodhpur, the afternoon temperature frequently rises ___ 45 degrees Celsius."
questions.explanation: Jab kisi scale, benchmark, standard, ya measurement (jaise temperature, sea level, passing marks) par higher level denote karna ho, toh strictly 'ABOVE' use hota hai: 'above 45°C', 'above sea level'. 'Over' vertically physically covering position ya movement ke liye lagta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-09: Above vs Over — ABOVE for levels, benchmarks, and temperatures on a vertical scale.
questions.hint: Scale ya thermometer reading par level ke liye kaunsa word aata hai?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Relative Position: Over for Vertical Coverage
questions.question:
Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition:
"The court orderly held a large black umbrella ___ the senior judge's head as it started raining heavily."
questions.explanation: Jab koi object kisi entity ke directly vertical align hokar use cover ya shelter karta hai, toh preposition 'OVER' lagta hai: 'held an umbrella over his head'. 'Above' bina covering ke sirf higher position batata hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-09: Above vs Over — OVER for direct vertical coverage and shelter.
questions.hint: Direct vertical coverage ke liye 'over' lagta hai ya 'above'?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Movement: Traversal of 3D Aperture with Through
questions.question:
Fill in the blank:
"The armed security convoy passed safely ___ the fortified gate of the High Court."
questions.explanation: Gate, doorway, tunnel, ya entrance ek 3D aperture/passage hota hai jiske andar se hokar movement nikalti hai. 3D opening se pass hone ke liye strictly 'THROUGH' lagta hai: 'passed through the gate'. 'Across' 2D open plane (jaise road/river) ke ek side se doosre side jaane ke liye hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-05: Movement Vectors — THROUGH for passing inside a 3D aperture, opening, or conduit.
questions.hint: Gate ya darwaze ke andar se guzarne ke liye kya aayega?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Movement: Crossing 2D Surface with Across
questions.question:
Fill in the blank:
"The court process server walked ___ the busy highway to deliver the summons."
questions.explanation: Road ya highway ek 2D surface hoti hai jiske ek kinare se doosre kinare tak transverse movement ko describe karne ke liye 'ACROSS' lagta hai: 'walked across the highway'. 'Along' parallel chalne ke liye hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-05: Movement Vectors — ACROSS for traversing from one side of a 2D surface to the other.
questions.hint: Road ko ek side se cross karke doosre side jaane ke liye kaunsa word aata hai?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Parallel Path: Linear Movement with Along
questions.question:
Fill in the blank:
"Ornamental neem trees have been planted ___ the main road leading to the court complex."
questions.explanation: Road ke kinare-kinare parallel line mein sthit hone ya chalne ke liye preposition 'ALONG' lagta hai: 'planted along the road'.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-05: Movement Vectors — ALONG for linear parallel path following an edge.
questions.hint: Road ke kinare-kinare parallel alignment ke liye kya lagta hai?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Boundary Penetration: Pouring / Transferring into Enclosure
questions.question:
Fill in the blank with the correct preposition:
"The forensic investigator carefully poured the chemical reagent ___ the test tube."
questions.explanation: Action verb 'poured' liquid ke outside se inside motion ko describe kar raha hai jo test tube ke 3D interior mein ja raha hai. Motion crossing into an interior enclosure strictly 'INTO' demand karta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-03: In vs Into — INTO for dynamic action transferring something into an enclosed interior.
questions.hint: Liquid ko bahar se kisi container ke andar daalne ke liye kya aayega?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: By as Latest Completion Threshold
questions.question:
Fill in the blank:
"The System Assistant assured the Registrar that the network upgrade would be completed ___ tomorrow afternoon."
questions.explanation: Verb 'completed' point-action event hai aur 'tomorrow afternoon' latest deadline (not later than) mark kar raha hai. Completion deadlines ke liye strictly 'BY' use hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-06: By vs Until — BY marks the latest deadline for completion.
questions.hint: Kaam complete karne ki aakhiri deadline ke liye kya aayega?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Until as Terminal Duration Boundary
questions.question:
Choose the correct preposition:
"The advocate requested the judge to adjourn the hearing and wait ___ the ballistic expert arrived."
questions.explanation: Verb 'wait' ek continuous ongoing state hai jise expert ke aane tak continue rakhna hai. Continuing action up to an event strictly 'UNTIL' demand karta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-06: By vs Until — UNTIL marks duration continuing up to a terminal point.
questions.hint: Intezar kab tak jaari rakhna hai?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Completed Past Duration with Simple Past and For
questions.question:
Which of the following sentences correctly expresses a completed past duration?
A) The retired judge served on the State Human Rights Commission for four years.
B) The retired judge served on the State Human Rights Commission since four years.
C) The retired judge has served on the State Human Rights Commission for four years ago.
D) The retired judge had been serving on the Commission since four years.
questions.explanation: Jab koi past action complete ho chuka ho aur present se koi connection na ho, toh measured duration ('four years') ke pehle 'FOR' lagta hai aur verb Simple Past ('served') mein rehti hai. 'Since four years' ungrammatical hai. Sentence (A) 100% correct hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-07: Since vs For — FOR with Simple Past for completed past periods.
questions.hint: Past mein poora ho chuka 4 saal ka tenure Simple Past + 'FOR' lega.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Zero Preposition with Physical Enter
questions.question:
Identify the part containing an error in the sentence:
"The learned counsel / entered into the courtroom / without wearing his advocate's band / and was warned by the Bench."

options.text: and was warned by the Bench

questions.explanation: Jab verb 'enter' ka use physical space (courtroom, chamber, room, building) mein dakhil hone ke liye hota hai, toh iske sath preposition 'into' lagana strict grammatical error hai. Correct phrasing hai: 'entered the courtroom'.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-10: Zero Preposition Law — 'Enter' takes NO preposition for physical spaces.
questions.hint: Physical room mein entry ke liye 'enter' ke baad 'into' lagna chahiye ya nahi?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Zero Preposition with Verb Order
questions.question:
Choose the grammatically correct sentence:
A) The court manager ordered for three new desktop printers for the filing section.
B) The court manager ordered three new desktop printers for the filing section.
C) The court manager ordered to three new desktop printers for the filing section.
D) The court manager ordered on three new desktop printers for the filing section.
questions.explanation: Verb 'order' jab kisi commodity, goods, ya food ke demand ke liye use hoti hai, toh ye direct transitive verb hoti hai aur direct object leti hai (Zero Preposition). Iske baad 'for' lagana redundant pleonasm hai. Correct: 'ordered three new desktop printers'.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-10: Zero Preposition Law — 'Order' as a verb takes NO preposition.
questions.hint: Verb 'order' ke baad 'for' lagana galat hota hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Zero Preposition with Attack as a Verb
questions.question:
Spot the error in the sentence:
"The miscreants / attacked on the police patrol / near the district court / late at night."
questions.explanation: Verb 'attack' direct transitive verb hai jiska matlab hi hota hai kisi par aakraman karna. Iske baad preposition 'on' lagana strict error hai ('attacked the police patrol'). Note: Noun form mein 'launch an attack on' correct hota hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-10: Zero Preposition Law — 'Attack' as a verb takes NO preposition 'on'.
questions.hint: Verb 'attacked' ke baad 'on' redundant hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Beside as Physical Adjacent Location
questions.question:
Fill in the blank:
"The personal security officer stood vigilant ___ the judicial officer throughout the public hearing."
questions.explanation: 'Beside' (bina 's') ka matlab hota hai 'by the side of / next to' (bagal mein). 'Besides' (with 's') ka matlab hota hai 'in addition to' (ke alawa). Physical guard standing location ke liye 'beside' bilkul correct hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-09: Beside vs Besides — BESIDE for physical adjacent location.
questions.hint: Officer ke bagal mein khade hone ke liye 's' wala word aayega ya bina 's' wala?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Die of vs Die from Causation Distinction
questions.question:
Choose the sentence that correctly uses the preposition of causation:
A) The elderly petitioner died from cardiac arrest during the court recess.
B) The elderly petitioner died of cardiac arrest during the court recess.
C) The elderly petitioner died with cardiac arrest during the court recess.
D) The elderly petitioner died by cardiac arrest during the court recess.
questions.explanation: Medical illness, disease, ya internal biological failure (heart attack, cancer, cholera, malaria) se death hone par strictly 'DIE OF' lagta hai: 'died of cardiac arrest'. 'Die from' external causes (wound, overwork, snakebite, poison) ke liye lagta hai.
questions.ruleReference: Section 9: Die of for diseases/illnesses; Die from for external trauma/causes.
questions.hint: Internal disease ya heart attack ke liye 'die of' lagta hai ya 'die from'?
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11

questions.topic: Use of Articles, Determiners and Prepositions
questions.subtopic: Zero Preposition with Verb Resemble
questions.question:
Spot the error in the sentence:
"The junior clerk / closely resembles with / his elder brother / who also serves in the High Court."

options.text: who also serves in the High Court

questions.explanation: Verb 'resemble' direct transitive verb hai aur kisi preposition ('with' ya 'to') ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Correct: 'closely resembles his elder brother'.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-10: Zero Preposition Law — 'Resemble' takes NO preposition ('with' or 'to').
questions.hint: 'Resembles' ke baad 'with' lagana galat hota hai.
questions.provenanceSource: Authored for HSA EnglishMaster Module L11
